text:
SRE Bot: :rotating_light: Paging: sev2 - inference host pool degraded in us-west-2. Alerts triggered by 5xx spike on /v1/generate. oncall-sre has been paged.

oncall-sre: Acked. jumping in. quick triage — checking router logs and capacity.
Maya Chen: Seeing error ratio ~18% over 5m on the redwood-infer-prod cluster. Latency also up.
Devin Patel: I can flip a traffic split to fallback model variant if we need quick mitigation.
Jules Rivera: FYI ops-bot shows a recent deploy at 02:10 that touched routing. Could be related.
SRE Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0458. Bridge: #inc-0458-bridge. Post updates to status page once we have confirmed customer impact.
CS Ops: Customer-facing queue open. We should prepare a short, non-technical status blurb + a support macro for Zendesk.
Zack Kim: Draft status page update suggestion: "We are investigating elevated error rates for text-generation in us-west-2. Some requests may fail with 5xx. No data loss, working on a mitigation. Updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?
oncall-sre: Good. Add estimated affected % (~10-20%) and mention workaround "retry with exponential backoff or try region us-east-1"? Keep it conservative.
Maya Chen: I'll test switch to model-variant-b2 (lower memory) which worked in previous flapping incidents. If healthy, route 30% traffic there as canary.
Devin Patel: Preparing a canary traffic split now. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/route -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"service":"inference","variant":"b2","weight":30}'``` 
Jules Rivera: On bridge. Logs show OOMs on host gpu-uw2-12 around 02:06-02:09 — might be memory pressure from long-context requests.
CS Ops: Suggested support macro for Zendesk (short): "We're currently investigating an issue causing intermittent 5xx errors for text generation in us-west-2. Our engineers are working on mitigation. Please retry after a few minutes; region fallback (us-east-1) may work. We'll update you as soon as we have more info."
CS Ops: Longer CS template (for higher-tier customers): "Hi <customer>, apologies — we're seeing intermittent server errors in one of our regions affecting generation endpoints. Our engineers are actively mitigating, and you may experience temporary failures or increased latency. We recommend routing requests to us-east-1 or retrying with exponential backoff. We will follow up with a timeline and a post-incident summary."
Zack Kim: Internal ops macro (private): "Short: root cause under investigation; temporary traffic split to variant-b2; monitoring for errors to drop below 1%. Actions: canary routing, restart affected hosts, rollback deploy if needed."
Maya Chen: Canary in progress — variant b2 got 30% traffic at 02:18. Metrics: error rate on canary 1.2% vs primary 17%. Looks promising.
oncall-sre: Swap plan: if canary <3% errors for 10m, escalate to 70% and then 100%. If not, roll back and restart nodes.
Devin Patel: Rolling to 70% now. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-router -n prod` for quick refresh after traffic adjust.
Jules Rivera: Restarted 3/6 router pods — observing reduced 5xx after pod warmup.
SRE Bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai at 02:28 UTC. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0458
CS Ops: Pasting Zendesk macro code block for agents — copy/paste into reply: ```Subject: Service disruption in us-west-2
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors affecting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Workarounds: retry with backoff or route to us-east-1. We're actively mitigating and will follow up.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support``` 
Zack Kim: Also add a short Intercom proactive note: "If you're using us-west-2, you may see brief failures. We recommend retry/backoff or switch region." Keep <=200 chars.
CS Ops: Internal comms template for execs (one-line + impact): "Impact: Partial service degradation for text-generation in us-west-2; estimated <20% of customer requests affected. Mitigation: traffic split to variant-b2; ongoing. ETA next update in 30 minutes."
Maya Chen: Quick troubleshooting checklist for agents (internal): 1) Confirm customer region and endpoint 2) Check status.redwood.ai 3) Suggest retry with exponential backoff 4) Suggest region fallback 5) Escalate to #inc-0458-bridge if customer reports ongoing bulk failures.
Jules Rivera: Technical runbook snippets to include in the private macro: ```Check ingress logs: gcloud logging read "resource.labels.cluster_name=redwood-prod AND jsonPayload.path='/v1/generate'" --limit 50
Check GPU mem OOMs: ssh gpu-uw2-12; sudo journalctl -u nvidia-driver | tail -n 200``` 
oncall-sre: Good. Also include a pointer to the RCA ticket template for postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0458-RCA
Devin Patel: FYI some customers use sticky routing to us-west-2 — we should add that note to the support reply: "If your application pins instances/regions, switching config may be needed."
CS Ops: Updated Zendesk macro with sticky routing note. Macro saved as "INC-0458 - us-west-2 5xx". Agents can now select it.
Zack Kim: Monitoring: set an alert to auto-update on pager if error rate >10% for 5m to avoid manual paging gaps.
SRE Bot: Alert rule updated at 02:31.
Maya Chen: Error rate down to 2.6% overall after 70% rollout; moving to 100% at 02:38.
Jules Rivera: 100% traffic on variant-b2 now. Observability: traces look healthy.
oncall-sre: Preparing handoff note for next oncall: include what we changed, where to look, and open follow-ups (RCA, config audit of deploy-time memory limits).
CS Ops: Customer update scheduled: final update + ETA for RCA within 72 hours. Draft: "Issue mitigated. Customers may have seen intermittent failures; the team is preparing a post-incident report."
Zack Kim: Closing bridge in 10m if no regressions.
SRE Bot: Incident moved to 'Mitigated' at 02:46. Please file RCA and link to ticket.
Maya Chen: Filing RCA now, will include memory limit diff and deploy artifact hash.
Devin Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up task for infra: bake model-variant-b2 into canary deploys for long-context workloads.
CS Ops: Handoff complete. Agents: use macro "INC-0458 - us-west-2 5xx" for any inbound tickets. :thumbsup:
Zack Kim: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
